_comment: Strong Card hooks. Merge the 'hooks' key into a project's .claude/settings.json. Copy the .sh/.py files to .claude/hooks/ and chmod +x. Requires jq, python3, and git on PATH. Refreshed 2026-09-15 against the live ~/.claude/settings.json on the reference machine -- see docs/reviews/2026-09-15-global-hooks-audit/report.md section 2.3 for what had drifted (this file previously listed 5 of 6 live PreToolUse/Bash hooks and 2 of 4 live PostToolUse/Bash hooks, and carried an older/shorter SessionStart wording). herdr-agent-state.sh (SessionStart) and mom-trigger.py (UserPromptSubmit) are intentionally NOT included here -- they are machine-local/3rd-party, not part of the Strong Card doctrine itself.

hooks.command: echo 'Strong Card rules are GLOBALLY in effect (source of truth: /Users/misterj/src/strong-cards_wip): every model dispatch (opencode/local worker, Luna, DeepSeek, or any coder) runs in its own git worktree, never the primary working tree; every tree is committed before dispatch and every verified card is committed to close it out; every self-report is independently re-verified via git diff --stat + direct test execution, never trusted at face value; every card that fails its first attempt or stalls gets a Sonnet (low-effort) judge pass before any retry, and the judge updates strong-cards_wip RULES.md/hooks when a failure teaches a general lesson.'
